points: Preheat your oven to 240°C/220°C fan/gas mark 9.
Bring a large saucepan of water with ½ tsp salt to the boil on high heat for the potatoes.
Pop the sausages onto a baking tray.
When the oven is hot, roast on the top shelf until browned and cooked through, 16-18 mins. Turn halfway through.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw meat. The sausages are cooked when no longer pink in the middle

steps.title: Roast the Sausages

points: Meanwhile, quarter the salad potatoes (no need to peel).
When boiling, add the potatoes to the water, lower the heat to medium and cook until tender, 15-20 mins.
While the potatoes boil, halve, peel and chop the shallot into small pieces.
Quarter, core and thinly slice the apple (no need to peel).
steps.title: Boil the Potatoes

points: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium frying pan on medium heat.
Add the shallot and cook until softened, 4-5 mins.
While the shallot fries, peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press). Finely chop the chives (use scissors if easier).
Add the garlic to the shallot and cook for 30 secs.
steps.title: Finish Prepping

points: Pour half the cider vinegar into the shallot pan and allow it to evaporate.
Add the sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts), chicken stock paste and half the mustard.
Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer until thickened, 2-3 mins.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the remaining cider vinegar with the sugar and olive oil for the dressing (see pantry for both amounts). Season with salt and pepper and set aside for now.
steps.title: Build the Flavour

points: In a small bowl, mix the mayo and half the mustard.
When the sauce has thickened, stir in the butter (see pantry for amount) until melted, then remove from the heat.
Stir the chives into the sauce. Cover with a lid or foil to keep warm.
Once the potatoes are cooked, drain with a colander, then return to the pan and spoon over the sauce and toss to coat the potatoes.
steps.title: Final Touches

points: When the sausages are cooked, drizzle over the honey (see pantry for amount) and turn to coat.
Add the apple and baby leaves to the salad dressing and toss.
Share the sausages between your plates.
Serve the apple salad, warm potato salad and mustard mayo alongside.
steps.title: Serve
